post.summary: Create a task from a raw Quick Add line
post.description: Parses the Quick Add grammar (natural-language due, `{deadline}`, `#project`, `/section`, `@label`, `p1`–`p4`, `// description`, leading `* ` uncompletable, `!` reminders). Missing projects/sections/labels are auto-created. Parsed `!` reminder tokens are persisted; a relative reminder is skipped when the task has no due time.

Completes a non-recurring task (and its open subtasks). A recurring task advances to its next occurrence and stays open unless the (optional) JSON body `{ "complete_series": true }` forces a final completion, or the recurrence has passed its `until` bound.

requestBody.description: Optional. Omit entirely (or send `{}`) to complete one task/occurrence.

complete_series.description: Fully complete a recurring task instead of advancing it.

409.description: Task is uncompletable or already completed

post.description: Clears `completed_at`, reopens any completed ancestors, and decrements that day’s completion count.

404.description: A task id does not belong to the user

400.description: Invalid reference (foreign/unknown id, or a parent cycle)

delete.summary: Soft-delete a task and its subtree

post.summary: Restore a soft-deleted task and its subtree
post.description: Clears `deleted_at` on the task and every row deleted in the same cascade (delete stamps an identical `deleted_at` across the subtree). Powers the delete-task undo.

404.description: No soft-deleted task with that id

post.summary: Restore a soft-deleted project and its cascade
post.description: Clears `deleted_at` on the project and every section/task deleted in the same cascade (delete stamps an identical `deleted_at`). Powers the delete-project undo.

200.description: Sections (unpaginated envelope); all of the user, or one project when filtered

post.summary: Restore a soft-deleted section and re-attach its tasks
post.description: Clears `deleted_at` on the section and re-attaches the tasks it was deleted with (delete detaches them, stamping `updated_at` with the same instant). Powers the delete-section undo.

200.description: Comments on a task, oldest first

post.description: Multipart upload (`file` field required). The stored name is the sanitized basename of the uploaded filename, and the returned `file_url` is the authenticated download path.

400.description: Missing `file` field or not a multipart form

413.description: Upload exceeds the configured size cap

get.description: Streams the stored bytes with the stored content type. `filename` must equal the stored file name. Images are served `inline`, everything else as an `attachment` download.

200.description: The file bytes (content-type is the stored file type)

404.description: Unknown attachment, foreign owner, or filename mismatch

patch.description: Updates the display name only. Email, password, 2FA and connected-provider changes go through better-auth endpoints under /api/auth/* and are not reimplemented here.

Shallow top-level merge onto the stored document; only the keys present in the request body are changed. `viewPrefs` merges per view key (provided keys replace, others are kept). `autoReminderMinutes` accepts exactly null, 0, 5, 10, 15, 30, 45, 60, or 120 — the extra heads-up before a timed due. Tasks with a due time always get an at-time reminder; null means no extra heads-up and 0 is a back-compat alias for null.

get.summary: List API tokens (never returns the secret value)

post.description: The full `ot_…` value is returned exactly once and is never retrievable again.

get.description: Newest-first, unlimited history. Each item carries a read-time-denormalized `payload` (`content`, `project_name`, and the stored event payload under `meta`). Filter by `types` (csv), `event_type` (single), `entity_type`, `project_id`, and `since`/`until`.

get.summary: Full-text search across tasks and comments

200.description: Ranked search hits; each hit carries the matching task and where it matched

get.description: Long-lived `text/event-stream` carrying only the authenticated user’s mutations. Emits `sync` frames (one per mutation, JSON body `{type,entity,ids,at}` with the sequence number in the SSE `id:` field) and periodic `ping` heartbeats. Reconnect with the `Last-Event-ID` header (or `?last_event_id=`; the header wins) to replay events buffered in the in-memory ring since that id.

schema.description: Replay events with a greater id (the Last-Event-ID header wins).

parameters.description: Replay events with a greater id (the Last-Event-ID header wins).
parameters.name: last_event_id

200.description: An open event stream of `sync` and `ping` frames.

get.description: All of the caller’s reminders, optionally scoped to one task via `task_id`.

post.description: Attaches a reminder to a task. `relative` fires `minute_offset` minutes before the task’s due time and requires the task to have a due date+time; `absolute` fires at its own due date+time; `recurring` fires on its own recurrence. The next fire instant is (re)computed from the task’s timezone-aware due.

400.description: Validation failed, or a relative reminder on a task with no due time

post.description: Dispatches a canned "Reminders are working." notification to every push subscription and enabled notification channel, returning a per-sink delivery summary. Bypasses the scheduler and never touches any channel’s failure counters.

patch.description: Changes a relative reminder’s `minute_offset` or an absolute/recurring reminder’s `due`, then recomputes the fire instant (re-arming the reminder when the instant changes).

delete.description: Hard-deletes the reminder. Deleting an automatic reminder does not disable auto-reminders — the next write to the task recreates it while the user’s `autoReminderMinutes` still calls for one.

get.summary: Get the calendar-feed token (auto-created on first call)
get.description: Returns the read-only iCal feed token and URLs, creating the token on first call. The token in the feed URL IS the credential — anyone with the URL can read the calendar, so treat it as a secret and rotate it if it leaks.

post.description: Issues a fresh token; the previous feed URL stops working immediately, so existing calendar subscriptions must be re-added with the new URL.

Multipart upload (`audio` file field). Persists the audio and starts the transcribe→extract pipeline. Rejects with 409 when no speech-to-text provider is configured, and 413 when the file exceeds the configured upload cap.

400.description: Missing `audio` field or not a multipart form

413.description: Upload exceeds the configured size cap

get.description: Newest first, single page (limit 50). `next_cursor` is always null.

delete.description: Hard-deletes the row and its audio file. Rambles are transient capture state.

post.description: Valid from status `uploaded` or a `failed`@`transcribe`. On success the ramble becomes `transcribed`; on provider failure it becomes `failed` with `failedStage: transcribe` and an error message (returned with HTTP 200, not an error status).

409.description: Ramble is not in a transcribable state

post.description: Valid from status `transcribed`, `extracted`, or a `failed`@`extract`. Requires a transcript. The `none` extractor also lands on `extracted` for a uniform client flow.

409.description: Ramble is not in an extractable state or has no transcript

post.description: Creates tasks from the (edited) items through the same path as `POST /tasks/quick`, marks the ramble `confirmed`, and deletes the audio file. Valid only from status `extracted`. If task creation throws midway the ramble stays `extracted` and the client may re-confirm (already-created tasks are not rolled back).

409.description: Ramble is not in the extracted state

get.description: Per-slot effective config (user override > instance env > none). Never returns key material — only `hasApiKey` and the `source` of the effective config.

put.description: Slot-level override: a non-null `provider` replaces the whole instance-default slot for this user. `apiKey`: string = set (stored AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest), null = clear, omitted = keep the stored value. `provider: null` reverts the slot to the instance default.

post.description: Transcribes a short silent WAV through the candidate config (or the saved/env config when no candidate is supplied). A missing candidate `apiKey` reuses the stored/env key. Provider or transport failures are returned as `{ok:false, detail}` with HTTP 200.

Runs the extractor over a fixed sample transcript. When extraction is disabled (no provider, or `none`), returns `{ok:true}` explaining that rambles become a single task. Provider or transport failures are returned as `{ok:false, detail}` with HTTP 200.

patch.summary: Update backup settings (null field = fall back to env/default)

post.summary: Restore from an uploaded backup zip (replaces ALL data)
post.description: Multipart upload (`file` field, a backup zip, up to 2 GiB). A pre-restore safety snapshot is taken first and the app pauses (503) while the swap runs.

400.description: Missing file or invalid/unverifiable backup zip

409.description: A restore is already in progress

413.description: Upload exceeds the 2 GiB restore cap

post.summary: Import from a Todoist backup zip
post.description: Multipart form: `file` (a Todoist backup .zip of per-project CSVs) plus an optional `mode` (`dry-run` | `apply`, default `dry-run`). Starts a background job and returns its id; poll `GET /import/jobs/{id}` for progress and the final report.

400.description: Missing `file` field or not a multipart form

413.description: Upload exceeds the 256 MiB import cap

post.description: JSON body `{ token, mode?, baseUrl? }`. The token is used only to fetch your Todoist data and is never persisted or logged. `baseUrl` targets a self-hosted mirror. Starts a background job and returns its id; poll `GET /import/jobs/{id}`.

get.description: Returns the job status, current progress, and (when finished) the import report.

get.summary: Karma, goals, streaks, and rollups for the current user

patch.description: Partial update of dailyGoal / weeklyGoal / daysOff / vacationMode / karmaEnabled. Values are merged into the shared user-settings document and re-validated.

get.summary: Export all data as canonical JSON
get.description: Downloads a single, self-contained JSON document of your whole account (projects, sections, labels, filters, tasks, comments, reminders, settings). Completed tasks are included; soft-deleted rows and attachment file bytes are not. Requires a session or `read_write` token.

200.description: The export document (served as a file download)

403.description: A read-only token cannot export all data

get.summary: Export all data as a Todoist-compatible CSV zip
get.description: Downloads a zip with one CSV per non-archived project, in the same per-project column shape Todoist's backup export uses (re-importable here or into Todoist). Active tasks only. Requires a session or `read_write` token.

200.description: A zip of per-project CSV files (served as a file download)

403.description: A read-only token cannot export all data
